name: EG Industries Berhad
overview: 今年公司通过泰国子公司SMT Industries收购土地，并增持泰国上市公司N.D. Rubber至41.59%，扩展能源与电动车相关业务；同时营收与净利润均同比增长。
overview_en: This year, the company acquired land through its Thai subsidiary SMT Industries and increased its stake in Thailand-listed N.D. Rubber to 41.59%, expanding into energy and EV-related solutions; meanwhile, revenue and net profit both increased year-on-year.

segments.name: 电子制造服务
segments.note: 今年通过泰国子公司收购土地，用于扩展制造业务。
segments.note_en: This year, the company acquired land through its Thai subsidiary to expand manufacturing operations.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司SMT Industries Co., Ltd.以610万令吉收购一块永久业权土地。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary SMT Industries Co., Ltd. acquired a piece of freehold land for RM6.1 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年增持泰国上市公司N.D. Rubber股权至41.59%，以强化在能源和电动车相关解决方案的地位。
segments.note_en: This year, the company increased its stake in Thailand-listed N.D. Rubber to 41.59% to strengthen its position in energy and EV-related solutions.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以每股1.50泰铢收购N.D. Rubber额外8000万股（17.51%股权），持股增至41.59%。
actions.text_en: Acquired an additional 80,000,000 shares (17.51% stake) in N.D. Rubber at THB1.50 per share, increasing shareholding to 41.59%.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过增持N.D. Rubber股权至41.59%，扩展至能源和电动车相关解决方案业务。
model_changes.text_en: Expanded into energy and EV-related solutions by increasing stake in N.D. Rubber to 41.59%.
